newsitem.title: USA: Donna Karan faces shareholder suit -lawyers.
newsitem.headline: Donna Karan faces shareholder suit -lawyers.

text.p: A shareholder suit was filed against Donna Karan International Inc, alleging that the company failed to disclose cost-control problems that hurt its income and ability to grow, lawyers for the plaintiffs said Friday.
The law firm Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach Llp issued a news release saying it filed the suit Thursday in U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York.
The lawyers said they were seeking class-action status in the suit, filed on behalf those who bought stock of Donna Karan International between June 28, 1996 and May 7, 1997.
Plaintiffs are seeking damages, the lawyers said.
A spokesperson from Donna Karan was not immediately available.
